text.en:
1. (1) This notification may be cited as the Free Zones (Declared Areas)
(Amendment) Notification 2000.

(2) This Notification comes into operation on 24 August 2000.
Amendment of Schedule

2. The Schedule to the Free Zones (Declared Areas) Notification 1992 (P.U.
(B) 465/92] is amended by substituting for the words "Gazette Plan 295"
appearing in item (ii) under the heading "Limits of Zones" the words "Gazette

Plan 429".

Made 4 August 2000.
[3 Sulit KE. HE(96) 966/01; Perb. 0.3865/41 Vol. 3; PN(PU?)485/III]

On behalf and in the name of the Minister of Finance,

CHAN Kong Choy
Deputy Minister of Finance

P.U. (A) 319.
AKTA ZON BEBAS 1990

PEMBERITAHUAN Zon BEBAS (Pindaan) 2000

Papa menjalankan kuasa yang diberikan oleh subseksyen 10(2) Akta Zon Bebas
1990 (Akta 438), Menteri membuat pemberitahuan yang berikut:

Nama dan permulaan kuat kuasa
